review_evidence: README describes a reactive streams library implementing Kotlin Coroutines Flow-style Flow, SharedFlow, StateFlow, ProgramFlow, and ReactiveProgram APIs.

Complete scan of the primary Lean sources found no theorem, lemma, axiom, or proposition-example declarations; the source defines IO/channel/mutex-backed stream data structures and executable operations.
Comments describe intended hot/cold/replay/state behavior, but the repository contains no independently proved stream specification, concurrency semantics, or implementation-correctness theorems.

source_action.content_invariant: Its primary Lean source implements Flow/SharedFlow/StateFlow/ProgramFlow APIs and concurrency plumbing, with no proposition/proof declarations or independently proved stream semantics; retirement removes no mathematical theorem/proof or formal-specification corpus.
